items.title: VRCycle: A Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial Evaluating a Virtual Reality Cycling Intervention in People With Knee Osteoarthritis.
items.summary: A two-arm feasibility RCT with 41 knee osteoarthritis participants found that VR-enhanced cycling was highly feasible and acceptable, with 91% adherence and 90% retention. Both VR-enhanced and traditional cycling showed within-group improvements in pain, function, and exercise capacity, supporting progression to a full efficacy trial.
items.curatedReason: 这项可行性 RCT 表明，VR 辅助骑行对膝骨关节炎患者可行且可接受，初步疗效与传统骑行相似。这支持了将 VR 融入膝 OA 康复方案的进一步研究。
items.titleZh: VRCycle：一项评估虚拟现实骑行干预对膝骨关节炎患者可行性的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 41 名膝骨关节炎患者进行的双臂可行性随机对照试验发现，VR 辅助骑行具有高度可行性和可接受性，依从性达 91%，留存率达 90%。VR 辅助骑行和传统骑行均在组内疼痛、功能和运动能力方面显示改善，支持进一步开展全面疗效试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This feasibility RCT suggests that VR-enhanced cycling is feasible and acceptable for knee osteoarthritis patients, with preliminary efficacy similar to traditional cycling. This supports further research into integrating VR into knee OA rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项可行性研究，样本量小，未设功效以评估疗效，因此不能得出确切的治疗效果结论。
items.limitationEn: As a feasibility study with a small sample size, it was not powered to evaluate efficacy, thus definitive conclusions on treatment effects cannot be drawn.

items.title: Effects of adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy on postural responses and autonomic function in individuals with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-blind RCT with 30 MS patients found that adjunctive craniosacral therapy to conventional physiotherapy reduced response latency in specific postural tests (Adaptation Test toes-down: p = .034; Motor Control Test back-small: p = .006), but showed no significant between-group differences at any time point or for autonomic function.
items.curatedReason: 本 RCT 提示，颅骶疗法（CST）作为多发性硬化症传统理疗的辅助手段，可能对特定姿势反应参数产生影响。但在更大的患者群体中，其对姿势控制和自主神经功能的明确优越性仍需更多研究验证。
items.titleZh: 颅骶疗法作为辅助手段对多发性硬化症患者姿势反应和自主神经功能的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 30 名多发性硬化症患者进行的单盲随机对照试验发现，颅骶疗法作为传统理疗的辅助手段，在特定姿势测试（适应性测试脚趾朝下：p = .034；运动控制测试背部小肌：p = .006）中缩短了反应潜伏期，但任何时间点或自主神经功能方面均未显示显著组间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that craniosacral therapy (CST) as an adjunct to conventional physiotherapy in MS might influence specific postural response parameters. However, its definitive superiority for postural control and autonomic function in a larger patient population requires further validation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（30 人），且未显示颅骶疗法对自主神经功能的显著治疗效果，限制了结论的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size (30 participants) and lack of significant treatment effect on autonomic function for craniosacral therapy limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Physical calibration and signal periodic updates to synchronize IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking
items.summary: A study with 15 volunteers demonstrated that combining physical calibration with signal-based periodic updates effectively synchronized wearable IMUs for 5-day continuous knee flexion tracking, achieving high correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees) compared to motion capture, enabling accurate real-world kinematic monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 对膝关节屈曲的长期、连续性运动学追踪，这项方法在真实世界中有可能实现。这项小样本研究提示，你也许能通过物理校准与信号更新结合的方式，让可穿戴 IMU 系统达到长达 5 天的精确度，相关性 (r ≥ 0.971) 和 RMSD (≤ 6.2 度) 都表现不错。
items.titleZh: 用于 5 天连续膝关节屈曲跟踪的 IMU 物理校准和信号周期性更新同步方法
items.summaryZh: 一项涉及 15 名志愿者的研究表明，将物理校准与基于信号的周期性更新相结合，可有效同步可穿戴惯性测量单元（IMU），实现长达 5 天的膝关节屈曲连续跟踪。与运动捕捉相比，该方法实现了高相关性（r ≥ 0.971）和低均方根差（RMSD ≤ 6.2 度），从而实现准确的真实世界运动学监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: Long-term, continuous kinematic tracking of knee flexion might be achievable in real-world settings with this method. This small-sample study suggests you could achieve accurate 5-day tracking with wearable IMU systems by combining physical calibration with signal updates, showing good correlation (r ≥ 0.971) and low RMSD (≤ 6.2 degrees).
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康志愿者，在临床患者人群中，长期穿戴 IMU 的依从性和同步精度可能需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted on healthy volunteers; adherence to long-term IMU wear and synchronization accuracy in clinical patient populations may require further validation.

items.title: Cellular health beyond body composition: phase angle suitability for breast cancer patients undergoing physical training: a randomised trial
items.summary: A randomized trial with 37 breast cancer patients found no significant between-group differences in phase angle (PhA) or body composition between home-based and hospital-supervised high-intensity training. Changes in PhA (p < 0.0001), BMI (p = 0.0377), fat mass (p = 0.0387), and muscle mass (p = 0.0449) were primarily treatment-dependent, supporting structured home-based exercise and PhA as an independent cellular health marker.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对乳腺癌患者而言，无论是居家运动还是医院监督下的高强度训练，身体成分和血参数的变化主要取决于化疗而非运动模式。这意味着你可以更灵活地为乳腺癌患者开具运动处方，同时相位角（PhA）可作为细胞和代谢状态的独立指标。
items.titleZh: 身体成分之外的细胞健康：相位角在接受体育训练的乳腺癌患者中的适用性：一项随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项对 37 名乳腺癌患者进行的随机试验发现，居家运动组和医院监督下高强度训练组在相位角（PhA）或身体成分方面没有显著组间差异。相位角（p < 0.0001）、BMI（p = 0.0377）、脂肪量（p = 0.0387）和肌肉量（p = 0.0449）的变化主要与治疗相关，支持结构化居家运动和将 PhA 作为独立的细胞健康标志物。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that for breast cancer patients, changes in body composition and blood parameters are primarily chemotherapy-dependent, not exercise modality-dependent, for both home-based and supervised high-intensity training. This implies greater flexibility in prescribing exercise for breast cancer patients, with phase angle (PhA) serving as an independent indicator of cellular and metabolic status.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（37 人），且居家组和医院组在训练监督强度和环境上存在差异，可能影响结果的可比性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (37 participants), and differences in supervision intensity and environment between home-based and hospital-based groups may affect comparability of results.

items.title: Increasing Efficiency in Resistance Training? Exploring a Minimalistic Approach in Supramaximal Accentuated Eccentric Loading: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes evidence on supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL), indicating its potential to promote strength gains with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week) due to high eccentric mechanical stimulus. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are sparse, and evidence on physiological adaptations primarily comes from eccentric-only training.
items.curatedReason: 超最大离心负荷 (SAEL) 训练在提高力量方面可能有效，即便训练容量很低（每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）。如果你在寻找一种高机械刺激、低训练量的方案，这可能值得尝试。但请注意，目前与传统阻力训练的直接比较研究还很有限。
items.titleZh: 提高阻力训练效率？探索超最大离心负荷中的极简主义方法：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 本叙述性综述综合了超最大离心负荷（SAEL）的证据，表明其通过高离心机械刺激，有望以低训练量（例如，每周 2-4 组，每组 3-8 次）促进力量增长。然而，与传统阻力训练的直接比较稀少，且生理适应性证据主要来自纯离心训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: Supramaximal accentuated eccentric loading (SAEL) training may be effective for strength gains, even with low volumes (e.g., 2–4 sets of 3–8 repetitions per week). If you're looking for a high mechanical stimulus with low training volume, this might be worth exploring. However, direct comparisons with traditional resistance training are still sparse.
items.limitation: 该综述是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且大部分证据来自高强度离心训练而非 SAEL 干预本身，缺乏与传统阻力训练的直接比较。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, which may be subject to selection bias, and much of the evidence is derived from high-intensity eccentric-only training rather than SAEL interventions, lacking direct comparisons with traditional resistance training.

items.title: Squeezing more out of less: blood-flow restriction training in COPD and other conditions, from the clinic to the home
items.summary: This review highlights blood flow restriction (BFR) training as a strategy to address exercise intolerance in COPD and other populations. BFR allows low-load exercise (20–40% 1RM) to achieve strength gains comparable to high-load training, offering a solution for improving peripheral muscle function when exertional dyspnoea or other limitations restrict high-intensity training.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述阐述了血流限制（BFR）训练在 COPD 患者肺康复中的潜力，以及如何将其从临床扩展到居家环境。它提醒你，对于运动不耐受或无法进行高负荷训练的患者，BFR 训练能以低负荷实现与高负荷相似的力量和耐力增益，是改善外周肌肉功能、克服呼吸困难限制的有效策略。
items.titleZh: 事半功倍：血流限制训练在 COPD 和其他疾病中的应用，从临床到居家
items.summaryZh: 本综述强调血流限制（BFR）训练是一种解决 COPD 及其他人群运动不耐受的策略。BFR 允许低负荷运动（20-40% 1RM）实现与高负荷训练相当的力量增益，为当劳力性呼吸困难或其他限制阻碍高强度训练时，改善外周肌肉功能提供了一种解决方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review elucidates the potential of blood flow restriction (BFR) training in pulmonary rehabilitation for COPD patients and its applicability from clinic to home settings. It reminds you that for patients with exercise intolerance or inability to perform high-load training, BFR training can achieve similar strength and endurance gains at low loads compared to high loads, making it an effective strategy to improve peripheral muscle function and overcome dyspnea limitations.
items.limitation: 这是一篇综述，而非原始研究，因此其结论是基于现有文献的综合，可能受到纳入研究异质性的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a review, not original research, so its conclusions are based on a synthesis of existing literature and may be influenced by heterogeneity of included studies.

items.title: Match Exposure and Estimated Travel Before ACL Injury in Professional Women’s Football: An Exploratory Within-Player Case-Crossover Study
items.summary: An exploratory case-crossover study of 375 professional women's footballers found slightly greater match exposure (d = 0.21–0.37) and estimated travel distance (2724 ± 4821 km vs 2194 ± 4625 km, p < 0.001) during ACL injury seasons compared to control periods. No travel was associated with lower odds of injury, but effect sizes were small, indicating contextual patterns for further investigation rather than causality.
items.curatedReason: 这项对专业女子足球运动员的探索性研究表明，ACL 损伤季节的比赛暴露和估计旅行距离略有增加，但效应量较小。这提醒你在评估运动员 ACL 损伤风险时，要将比赛负荷和差旅因素纳入考量，但不能将其视为主要预测指标，需配合其他因素进行综合判断。
items.titleZh: 专业女子足球运动员 ACL 损伤前的比赛暴露和估计旅行：一项探索性队内病例交叉研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 375 名专业女子足球运动员进行的探索性病例交叉研究发现，ACL 损伤季节的比赛暴露（d = 0.21–0.37）和估计旅行距离（2724 ± 4821 公里 vs 2194 ± 4625 公里，p < 0.001）略有增加。未旅行与较低的受伤几率相关，但效应量较小，表明这些是需要进一步调查的背景模式而非因果关系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study in professional women's footballers suggests slightly greater match exposure and estimated travel distance in ACL injury seasons, but with small effect sizes. This reminds you to consider match load and travel factors when assessing ACL injury risk in athletes, but not as primary predictors; a comprehensive assessment with other factors is needed.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性病例交叉研究，无法建立因果关系，且效应量较小，受试者间差异较大，限制了结果的直接临床应用。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective case-crossover study, which cannot establish causality, and the small effect sizes with substantial inter-player variability limit direct clinical application of the findings.

items.title: Comprehensive Regulations to Uncover Suspicious Healthcare (CRUSH) Proposed Rule (CMS-6098-P)
items.summary: CMS has released comprehensive regulations to uncover suspicious healthcare (CRUSH) as a proposed rule (CMS-6098-P), outlining measures to target fraud.
items.curatedReason: CMS-6098-P 旨在加强打击医疗欺诈的力度，但这意味着所有参与 Medicare、Medicaid/CHIP 和 Marketplace 的物理治疗机构都将面临更严格的审查。请务必研究该拟议规则的每一个细节，并开始评估它对你的合规性、报销流程和日常运营可能带来的冲击。
items.titleZh: 揭露可疑医疗保健综合规定（CRUSH）拟议规则 (CMS-6098-P)
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了“揭露可疑医疗保健综合规定”（CRUSH）拟议规则（CMS-6098-P），概述了打击欺诈的措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS-6098-P signals a tougher stance on healthcare fraud, and by extension, heightened scrutiny for all physical therapy practices involved in Medicare, Medicaid/CHIP, and the Marketplace. You must review every detail of this proposed rule and begin assessing its potential impact on your compliance, reimbursement processes, and daily operations.

items.title: Next-generation control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons: State-of-the-art, limitations, and future directions.
items.summary: This review summarizes current control strategies for lower-extremity exoskeletons used in gait rehabilitation, highlighting that existing methods are often unintuitive and insufficient for seamless, user-driven assistance, with future directions focusing on advanced user intent determination.
items.curatedReason: 了解下肢外骨骼的控制策略进展对理解其临床潜力与局限至关重要。当前技术尚存在瓶颈，未来需关注用户意图检测和自适应性，这会直接影响康复效果。
items.titleZh: 下肢外骨骼的下一代控制策略：现状、局限和未来方向
items.summaryZh: 本综述总结了用于步态康复的下肢外骨骼当前控制策略，指出现有方法往往不够直观且不足以提供无缝、用户驱动的辅助，未来方向将侧重于先进的用户意图确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding advancements in lower-extremity exoskeleton control strategies is crucial for grasping their clinical potential and limitations. Current technology still faces bottlenecks, and future developments in user intent detection and adaptability will directly impact rehabilitation outcomes.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: User Experience of a Rehab Community-Based, Affordable Robot Exercise System (Rehab CARES) for Gamified Motor and Cognitive Stroke Rehabilitation
items.summary: Six adults with chronic stroke using Rehab CARES, a community-based robot exercise system, reported low pain, light to moderate perceived exertion, strong and stable enjoyment, and high usability scores (86/100) for personalized motor and cognitive training.
items.curatedReason: 这款康复机器人系统 Rehab CARES 提供了积极的用户体验，显示出其在社区环境中为卒中患者提供个性化运动/认知训练的潜力，为你将机器人技术整合到康复方案中提供参考。
items.titleZh: 基于社区的可负担机器人运动系统（Rehab CARES）用于游戏化运动和认知卒中康复的用户体验
items.summaryZh: 六名慢性卒中患者使用基于社区的机器人运动系统Rehab CARES进行个性化运动和认知训练，报告疼痛感低、感知劳累度轻至中度、享受度高且稳定，以及可用性评分高（86/100）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Rehab CARES robot exercise system demonstrated a positive user experience, indicating its potential to deliver personalized motor/cognitive training to stroke patients in a community setting, offering a reference for integrating robotic technology into your rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 样本量较小（成人），且为慢性卒中患者，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: Small sample size (adults) and focused on chronic stroke patients, limiting generalizability.

items.titleZh: 2026财年不当支付情况
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了关于2026财年不当支付情况的事实清单。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CMS fact sheet on Fiscal Year 2026 Improper Payments provides updated data on financial vulnerabilities within the healthcare system. Understanding this data can help you anticipate CMS's future regulatory focus on compliance and fraud prevention, which is valuable for your clinic's operations.

items.title: Use of Rehabilitation Therapy Services among World Trade Center Health Program Members with Cancer
items.summary: This study examines rehabilitation service utilization among World Trade Center Health Program members with cancer certification from 2011-2024 to understand their needs.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究提供了关于世贸中心健康项目成员中癌症患者康复服务利用的基线数据，为你了解该特定人群的康复需求和服务缺口提供初步参考。
items.titleZh: 世贸中心健康项目癌症成员康复治疗服务利用情况
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在考察2011-2024年间获得癌症认证的世贸中心健康项目成员康复服务利用情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study provides baseline data on rehabilitation service utilization among World Trade Center Health Program members with cancer, offering an initial reference for understanding the rehabilitation needs and service gaps in this specific population.
items.limitation: 回顾性研究设计，可能存在数据不完整或偏倚。
items.limitationEn: Retrospective study design, potential for incomplete data or bias.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Comparative Efficacy of Low-Level Laser Therapy in Patients With Carpal Tunnel Syndrome: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs found low-level laser therapy (LLLT) significantly reduced pain (Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001) and improved grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002) in carpal tunnel syndrome. Pulsed mode was superior for analgesia, while continuous mode better supported grip strength.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述和荟萃分析证实了低强度激光疗法（LLLT）对腕管综合征（CTS）的疼痛和握力有显著改善，并明确了脉冲模式更利于镇痛，连续模式更利于功能恢复。你可以在 CTS 患者的治疗方案中考虑 LLLT，并根据治疗目标（镇痛或功能恢复）选择合适的激光模式。
items.titleZh: 低强度激光疗法治疗腕管综合征患者的比较疗效：随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入16项随机对照试验的最新系统综述和荟萃分析发现，低强度激光疗法（LLLT）显著减轻了腕管综合征患者的疼痛（Hedges' g=-1.524, P <0.001）并改善了握力（Hedges' g=0.391, P=0.002）。脉冲模式在镇痛方面更优，而连续模式则更有利于握力恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 16 RCTs provides strong evidence: for carpal tunnel syndrome, LLLT significantly reduces pain (Hedges' g=-1.524) and improves grip strength (Hedges' g=0.391). In clinical practice, consider incorporating LLLT, selecting pulsed mode for analgesia or continuous mode for grip strength improvement based on patient priorities.
items.limitation: 尽管荟萃分析证据等级高，但可能仍存在纳入研究间的异质性，且部分次级结局如CSA的改善不显著。
items.limitationEn: Despite the high evidence level of meta-analysis, heterogeneity among included studies may exist, and improvements in some secondary outcomes, like CSA, were not significant.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: From "Tech Fear" to Digital Self-Efficacy: A COM-B and TDF Analysis of Tele-Exercise Engagement in Older Adults at Risk of Falls
items.summary: A qualitative study embedded in an RCT found that tele-exercise is feasible and acceptable for 25 older adults at risk of falls, despite initial digital literacy barriers, with participants successfully engaging and fostering digital self-efficacy through targeted behavior change techniques.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，即使老年患者在基线时数字素养较低，远程运动干预仍然可行且可接受，且依从性高。这提示你可以在跌倒风险老年人群中推广远程运动方案，不必过分担忧数字技术障碍，而应侧重于提供技术支持和个性化的行为改变技术。
items.titleZh: 从“技术恐惧”到数字自我效能：对跌倒风险老年人远程运动参与的COM-B和TDF分析
items.summaryZh: 一项嵌入随机对照试验的定性研究发现，远程运动对于25名有跌倒风险的老年人是可行且可接受的，尽管初始存在数字素养障碍，但参与者通过有针对性的行为改变技术成功参与并培养了数字自我效能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that telerehabilitation for exercise is feasible and acceptable for older adults at risk of falls, even with low baseline digital literacy, showing high adherence. This suggests you can promote tele-exercise programs in this population without excessive concern about digital barriers, focusing instead on technical support and tailored behavior change techniques.
items.limitation: 这是一项嵌套于RCT的定性研究，样本量较小（25名参与者），且结果基于对干预后的访谈，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study nested within an RCT, with a small sample size (25 participants), and results are based on post-intervention interviews, which may involve recall bias.

items.title: Education and training pathways for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists: a qualitative study investigating competency.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored advanced musculoskeletal practitioners' experiences with education and training in Tasmania, finding that current workplace-based training supports clinical expertise but lacks health-service collaboration, and highlighting opportunities for integrating external training and aligning policy and regulation to support competence.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了澳大利亚高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师在教育培训方面的系统性差距，强调了政策与监管亟需调整以支持能力提升。这提示你需要关注本地区（或借鉴澳大利亚的经验）PT 高级执业资格的认证与培训路径，并思考如何弥补培训需求与现有系统间的鸿沟。
items.titleZh: 高级肌肉骨骼物理治疗师的教育与培训路径：一项探讨能力的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了塔斯马尼亚地区高级肌肉骨骼实践者在教育和培训方面的经验，发现当前的工作场所培训支持临床专业知识但缺乏医疗服务协作，并强调了整合外部培训以及调整政策和法规以支持能力的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals systemic gaps in education and training for advanced musculoskeletal physiotherapists in Australia, highlighting the urgent need for policy and regulatory alignment to support competence. This prompts you to consider the certification and training pathways for advanced PT practice in your region (or learn from Australia's experience), and how to bridge the gap between training needs and current systems.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（12名参与者），结果主要反映塔斯马尼亚地区AMPs的经验。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (12 participants), reflecting the experiences of AMPs primarily in Tasmania.

items.title: The new body-as-machine: a response to Breedt, Tichenor, and Barlott's "Diagnosing the body in physiotherapy".
items.summary: This response article acknowledges and critically reflects on a landmark contribution to critical physiotherapy scholarship, which traces the evolving concept of the body from mechanical to modulated, highlighting tensions in existing analyses and raising issues for future resolution.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评是对物理治疗学界对“身体即机器”的反思。它并不会改变你的临床操作，但能让你从理论层面更深刻地理解当前生物-心理-社会模式的局限与演变，从而更好地参与学科内部的批判性对话。
items.titleZh: 新时代的“身体即机器”：对Breedt、Tichenor和Barlott的“物理治疗中的身体诊断”一文的回应
items.summaryZh: 这篇回应文章对批判性物理治疗学术领域的一项里程碑式贡献进行了肯定和批判性反思，该贡献追溯了身体概念从机械化到调控化的演变，并指出了现有分析中的张力及未来需要解决的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary critically reflects on the "body-as-machine" concept in physiotherapy. It won't change your clinical practice, but offers deeper theoretical insight into the limitations and evolution of the biopsychosocial model, preparing you for critical discourse within the profession.
items.limitation: 这是一篇批判性述评，不涉及实证研究数据或临床干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a critical commentary and does not involve empirical research data or clinical intervention outcomes.

items.title: Physiological responses during high intensity interval training and moderate intensity continuous training in patients attending early cardiac rehabilitation.
items.summary: In early outpatient cardiac rehabilitation, low-volume high-intensity interval training (HIIT) elicited greater ventilatory, hemodynamic, and metabolic demands, including higher mean VO₂, %VO₂R, and blood lactate, than time-matched moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT) in 18 stable coronary artery disease patients, despite higher perceived exertion.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在早期心脏康复中，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在生理刺激方面优于时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT），即便患者知觉劳累程度较高。这意味着可以考虑将 HIIT 作为冠心病患者个性化训练处方的一部分，以期获得更大的生理效益。
items.titleZh: 早期心脏康复患者进行高强度间歇训练和中等强度持续训练时的生理反应比较
items.summaryZh: 在早期门诊心脏康复中，低容量高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在 18 名稳定冠心病患者中引发了比时间匹配的中等强度持续训练（MICT）更高的通气、血流动力学和代谢需求，包括更高的平均摄氧量、最大摄氧量百分比和血乳酸，尽管患者的知觉劳累程度也更高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that low-volume high-intensity interval training (HIIT) provides a greater physiological stimulus than time-matched moderate-intensity continuous training (MICT) in early cardiac rehabilitation, despite higher perceived exertion. This suggests considering HIIT as part of personalized exercise prescriptions for CAD patients to achieve greater physiological benefits.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心、样本量小的交叉研究（18 名患者），结果需大型多中心研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center, small-sample (18 patients) crossover study, and its findings require validation by larger, multi-center studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
